items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Die Frist für die Einlegung des Einspruchs beträgt einen Monat.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 27.04.2026, sent by simple post. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Fri 01.05.2026; since that day is a public holiday (Tag der Arbeit) in NW, delivery shifts to the next business day, Mon 04.05.2026 (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO). The one-month Einspruch period begins with the end of that day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends one month later on Thu 04.06.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). That day is Fronleichnam, a public holiday in NW, so the deadline shifts to the next business day, Fri 05.06.2026 (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO).

warnings: The Einspruch deadline of 05.06.2026 computed from this letter has already passed as of today (26.09.2026) — if this is a real, current letter, check with the Finanzamt immediately whether any exception (e.g. Wiedereinsetzung in den vorigen Stand, or a later actual delivery date) still allows an objection, since a simple recalculation shows the one-month period is long over.

The refund of 888,00 € is to be paid into the IBAN printed on the letter (DE21 4405 0199 0123 4567 89); this IBAN passed a validity check (correct format and checksum, Sparkasse/Landesbank Muster, BLZ 44050199), but a valid IBAN does not confirm ownership — verify against the account you provided in your tax return before assuming money has arrived or will arrive there.
